name: Abinadab
bio: Abinadab was a man of Kirjath Jearim in whose house the ark of the covenant rested for twenty years. After the Philistines returned the ark, the men of Kirjath Jearim brought it into Abinadab's house on the hill and consecrated his son Eleazar to guard it (1 Samuel 7:1-2). Decades later, when David set out to bring the ark to Jerusalem, it was still there; Abinadab's sons Uzzah and Ahio drove the new cart that carried it out of his house, with Uzzah's death on the way becoming one of the episode's most sobering moments (2 Samuel 6:3-7).
